ui.title: AI Businesses: 13 from Worst to Best — and Where to Start
ui.description: Thirteen businesses you can start with artificial intelligence, rated by INEMA for technical demands, market opportunity, and durability. Plus a 6-question assessment, ready-to-use offers by industry, and a 90-day plan.
ui.nav_teste: Which one is right for you?
ui.hero_titulo: AI Businesses: from worst to best — and where to start
ui.hero_lead: Thirteen businesses you can start today with AI, ranked from worst to best for building, with INEMA’s scores for technical demands, market opportunity, and durability — plus a ladder showing where to enter and how to climb.
ui.hero_alt: AI Businesses banner: from worst to best for getting started
ui.resumo: Every day, a new business idea built around artificial intelligence appears, and choosing has become harder than building. This page rates thirteen of them on three 1-to-5 scales: how much technical knowledge you need to deliver something people will pay for, how much room there is in the market (more buyers than sellers), and how long the business can last and grow without being swallowed by a platform. The list ranks them from worst to best for building over the long term. That is not the same as the best one to start with: the top spot requires experience no one has on day one, and some businesses near the bottom are great first steps. The simple rule at the end is this: at the bottom, you sell what you build, which gets cheaper every month; at the top, you sell your judgment, which becomes more valuable. That is why the second part is a four-step ladder, with a 6-question assessment to find your step, a ready-to-use offer for each business, industry examples, and a 90-day plan. Prices in reais are reference ranges for what businesses charge, not a promise of earnings.
ui.notas_sub: None of the businesses on this list is bad: each works for someone. The scores show what kind of challenges you will face. The ranking is not the sum of the scores: durability and whether the business takes you to the next step carry more weight.
ui.n_tec_d: How much knowledge you need to deliver something people will pay for. A high score means it is harder.
ui.n_mer_d: Whether more people want to buy than are selling today. A high score means more room to grow.
ui.n_dur_d: Whether it can become a business that lasts for years without being swallowed by a platform. A high score means it is more resilient.
ui.rapido_sub: From 13th (worst business to build) to 1st (best). Tap a business to see its full profile.
ui.kpi: The metric you promise to improve
ui.rel_titulo: INEMA projects and courses to get started

ui.regra_titulo: At the bottom, you sell what you build. At the top, you sell your judgment.
ui.regra_texto: Building a website, automation, or app gets cheaper every month because AI does much of the work. Diagnosing the right problem, persuading a team to change, and taking responsibility for the outcome remain expensive because they depend on you. Starting at the bottom is not a mistake: that is where you gain experience and your first clients. The mistake is staying there.
ui.regra_cta: See the ladder and take the assessment
ui.escada_titulo: The AI Business Ladder: find your step and climb
ui.escada_desc: A 6-question assessment that points to your entry-level AI business, a ready-to-use offer for each step, examples by industry (clinic, accounting, real estate, law, restaurant), and a 90-day plan.
ui.escada_lead: Answer 6 questions, find out which business to start with, and see the ready-to-use offer, first client, and next step.
ui.degraus_sub: The higher you go, the less you sell building hours and the more you sell diagnosis and accountability. Clients from the lower step are the same ones who will buy from you at the next one.

ui.setores_sub: Clients do not buy “AI.” They buy fewer missed calls, more appointments, and fewer hours spent typing. Choose an industry and see the offer for each step.

ui.plano_sub: The plan works for any step. What changes is the offer you bring.
ui.foco_titulo: Choose one and stick with it
ui.foco_texto: People who succeed rarely chose the perfect business at the perfect time. They chose one, stuck with it long enough, and did not switch industries every three weeks. Use the assessment to decide, not to put off deciding.
ui.rodape: Open and free content from INEMA.CLUB
ui.aviso: Prices are reference ranges for what businesses charge in Brazil in 2026 (Brazil), not a promise of earnings. Results depend on the offer, industry, execution, and time.
ui.degrau_nota: The step is a different measure: it shows how much proof and trust you need to sell that business. That is why the list and ladder have different orders — the ladder helps you find where to enter.
ui.teste_topo: You are already at the highest step: the next move is to serve more companies or add the other business at the top.

negocios.curta: The most talked-about and hardest to start: building the app has become easy; getting people to pay every month has not.
texto: You build software with AI and charge people a monthly fee to use it. The potential is enormous, it can grow with a small team, and that is why it is the business that shows up most in success stories.

The problem is that building has become the cheap part. It has never been easier to launch an app, which means more competitors are fighting for the same attention. The real work is getting discovered, convincing people to pay, and keeping them from canceling. As usage grows, security and infrastructure costs add up. And an app that is just a thin layer over a model can die with the platform’s next update.
negocios.preco: R$ 29 to R$ 299 per month per client; you need hundreds of clients to make a living from it.
negocios.para_quem: People who already have an audience, a service business, or enough cash to go months without revenue.
negocios.armadilha: Building before you have buyers. Most SaaS businesses that grow started as a service that was already selling.
comecar: Sell the solution as a hands-on service to 3 clients
Write down what repeats across all of them
Only then turn the repeated part into an app
negocios.oferta: I solve [task] for [type of business] for a monthly fee, with nothing for you to install.

rel.nome: Immersion: From Zero to an AI App
rel.d: Go from prototype to AI-powered product, step by step.
Agents that test whether an idea has buyers before you build it.

negocios.curta: Cheap to start and good for learning, but views alone do not pay the bills.
texto: A YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram account where AI helps create the content and you stay off camera. Startup costs are almost zero, and you can test several formats quickly.

The money does not come from views; it comes from people who want to reach that audience: sponsors, your own products, or a paid community. Platforms do not monetize mass-produced repetitive content, and viral content without a defined audience does not attract anyone willing to pay. Start by thinking about who watches and who would pay to reach them.
negocios.preco: Sponsorships of R$ 300 to R$ 5,000 per post when the audience is engaged and focused on a niche.
negocios.para_quem: People who want to learn to create with AI and are willing to build an audience for months before earning money.
negocios.armadilha: Choosing a topic for its viral potential instead of thinking about who would pay to reach that audience. The platform can also change its rules overnight.
comecar: Choose a specific topic with clear advertisers (finance, health, tools)
Post 1 video a day for 30 days
List 10 brands that advertise in that niche
negocios.oferta: My channel reaches [audience] every day; your product gets in front of them for [price].
negocios.kpi: Niche followers and sponsorship price per post

rel.d: Create 16:9 videos without a camera or avatar, using a local voice.
Find what goes viral in your niche and make your own version.

negocios.curta: The best place for beginners to start: fast, visual, and easy to show. But there is a low ceiling.
texto: You build websites for small businesses with AI tools in an afternoon instead of taking weeks. You can create a demo of the client’s own website before speaking with them, which changes the conversation: they see it finished before paying.

Agencies still charge high prices for the old way of doing things, so you can enter at a lower price and deliver faster. The limit is that AI website builders cost just a few dozen reais a month, and the client will find out. Use this business to build momentum, a portfolio, and your first clients, then move up.
negocios.preco: R$ 1,500 to R$ 5,000 per website, plus R$ 100 to R$ 300 per month for maintenance.
negocios.para_quem: Complete beginners who want a first client quickly and something visual to show.
negocios.armadilha: Selling only websites. It is hard to get past a few thousand reais a month.
comecar: Choose 10 local businesses with poor or no websites
Make a demo for 3 of them in 20 minutes each
Send the link and offer to publish it
negocios.oferta: I made a new version of your website; if you like it, I can publish it this week.
negocios.kpi: Inbound inquiries from the website per month

rel.d: Turn references into a style, images, and a website ready to show.
Help your client’s website show up on Google and in AI search results.

negocios.curta: A great way to get inside a company and earn trust, but hard to tie to a financial result.
texto: You bring the company’s agents, automations, tools, and team knowledge together in one place: an assistant that knows its documents and processes and responds through the channel the company already uses.

It is an excellent entry point because once a client trusts you, they will buy larger projects. The weak point is measurement. Every offer needs a metric the owner tracks (sales, hours, service interactions), and a generic hub does not move a clear metric. It also only works if the owner already believes in AI; otherwise, the team will not change its habits and you will have no case study.
negocios.preco: R$ 5,000 to R$ 20,000 to set up, plus R$ 800 to R$ 3,000 per month.
negocios.para_quem: People who already know agents and automations and have access to tech-minded business owners.
negocios.armadilha: Selling the hub without tying it to a metric. Without measured results, you will not get referrals.
comecar: Choose a process with a clear metric (e.g., response time)
Build the hub just for that process
Measure before and after for 2 weeks
negocios.oferta: I bring everything your team asks about into one assistant, and we measure how much response time drops.
negocios.kpi: Hours saved per week across the team

rel.d: A foundation for running a company’s assistants in one place.
An assistant that works with your office files.

negocios.nome: Get your brand into AI answers (GEO)
negocios.curta: SEO for the ChatGPT era: money is coming in and few people are doing it, but you need to know how to prove results.
texto: You work to get a client’s brand recommended when someone asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or Perplexity a question. It is the next step in SEO (the work of getting a website to show up on Google), a market that has existed for decades and that companies know they need to pay for.

People who already do SEO have a huge advantage because they know how to measure and show results. Without that foundation, it is hard to prove the change came from your work. And the rules for which brands appear in answers can change at any time.
negocios.preco: R$ 2,000 to R$ 6,000 per month per client.
negocios.para_quem: People who already work in SEO, content, or digital marketing.
negocios.armadilha: Promising a spot in an AI answer. Promise the work and show measured progress.
comecar: Ask 3 AI systems 20 questions about the client’s industry and note which brands appear
Improve the website, data, and pages that the AI reads
Ask the 20 questions again after 30 days
negocios.oferta: Today, AI recommends your competitor when people ask about [service]. I work to change that and show you the measurements every month.
negocios.kpi: How many of the 20 questions mention the brand

rel.d: An SEO + GEO method for Google, Bing, and AI search.
Technical audits and AI search optimization with Claude Code.

negocios.curta: Demand keeps growing, but ready-made workflows have become a commodity. The value lies in finding the bottleneck.
texto: You connect AI to the systems a company already uses: its customer management system (CRM), email, spreadsheets, invoicing, and WhatsApp. It is where many people started, and it is still where service requests are most common.

But building automations is getting easier, and many companies already hire someone in-house to do it. A standalone workflow is worth little. What matters is finding the most costly bottleneck, tying the fix to a business result, and charging for that result — and that is already the consulting step.
negocios.preco: R$ 1,500 to R$ 6,000 per workflow; more when priced based on results.
negocios.para_quem: People who enjoy logic and tools and want a service with steady demand.
negocios.armadilha: Selling one workflow at a time and competing on price with thousands of people.
comecar: Ask the client which task takes the most team time
Automate only that task, measuring before and after
Use the result to sell a fix for the next bottleneck
negocios.oferta: Your team spends [X] hours a week on [task]. I automate it and show you the hours given back.
negocios.kpi: Hours returned to the team each week

rel.d: Build automations that connect your systems, step by step.
Find where a business is losing money and show it in reais.

negocios.curta: You get paid to teach and leave the room as “the AI person” at the company.
texto: You teach a company’s team to use AI in their daily work, using the company’s real cases. At many companies, the team already uses AI on its own without training, and the owner knows it.

The bigger payoff comes afterward. In the room, you see the company’s problems and earn trust right away. A larger project often follows the workshop. Teaching is a skill you can practice, and you need to know the tools you teach.
negocios.preco: R$ 3,000 for a half day to R$ 15,000 for a full day with a large group.
negocios.para_quem: People who enjoy explaining things, speak well in public, and already use AI in their own work.
negocios.armadilha: A generic “ChatGPT for beginners” workshop. Bring the company’s own cases, or nobody will use it the next day.
comecar: Build a 3-hour workshop with 5 real use cases for one industry
Run the first one free or at a low price in exchange for a testimonial
Always end with a diagnosis of what can be automated
negocios.oferta: In 3 hours, your team will start using AI for [5 tasks in your industry], with materials to keep going.
negocios.kpi: People using AI at work 30 days later

rel.d: Prepare people and companies to adopt AI thoughtfully.
Turn what you know into a method you can teach.

negocios.nome: AI receptionist and customer service agent
negocios.curta: AI that handles WhatsApp, phone, and website inquiries, books appointments, and hands off to a human. In Brazil, WhatsApp puts this business near the top.
texto: AI responds to messages, phone calls, and website chats, answers questions, books appointments, and calls a person when needed. It is easy to explain the return: the owner only has to count how many messages and calls went unanswered last month, and for a clinic, repair shop, or office, each one could be a lost client.

In Brazil, where almost everything goes through WhatsApp, the pain is even more visible. The risk is durability: scheduling and customer service systems these businesses already pay for are adding their own AI. The winners will be the people who know the industry and take care of setup, rules, and ongoing support.
negocios.preco: R$ 2,000 to R$ 8,000 to set up, plus R$ 500 to R$ 2,000 per month.
negocios.para_quem: People who want a recurring service and results that are easy for the owner to see.
negocios.armadilha: Selling the same generic AI to everyone. The system the client already uses will offer the same thing for less.
comecar: Choose an industry (clinic, repair shop, salon)
Build the demo around real questions from that industry
Show the owner how many messages went unanswered last month
negocios.oferta: Your clinic responds to every message, even at 10 p.m.: AI books the appointment and calls you when needed.
negocios.kpi: Messages and calls answered, and appointments booked

rel.d: AI customer service for clinics: scheduling, questions, and follow-up.
WhatsApp leads are routed immediately to an available team member.
For gyms: plans, available classes, and check-in through WhatsApp.

negocios.curta: Ads, videos, and carousels for brands. Anyone can press “generate”; clients pay for taste and results.
texto: You produce ads, commercials, carousels, and video edits for brands with AI. One person can now do what used to require a team and expensive equipment.

The other side is that anyone can press the generate button, including inside the ad platforms themselves, and the price per asset is falling. Clients pay for taste, for knowing which model suits which audience, and for using each ad’s numbers to make the next one better. If your ads sell, the client will stay.
negocios.preco: R$ 2,000 to R$ 8,000 per month per brand, packaged by deliverables.
negocios.para_quem: People with a good eye for visuals who enjoy video and want to track ad performance.
negocios.armadilha: Selling attractive assets one at a time. Sell a monthly package tied to campaign results.
comecar: Rework 3 ads from a brand you admire
Offer a 10-asset trial package
Show the results of each asset and adjust the next one
negocios.oferta: Every month, you get [N] new ads, and I replace the ones that do not sell with ones that do.
negocios.kpi: Cost per sale or per lead from campaigns

rel.d: Turn a script into carousels and stories ready to publish.
Create videos with code and a local voice, without a paid generator.
Pricing, packages, and portfolios for selling creative production.

negocios.curta: The clearest result on the list: more leads, more sales. If it works, nobody cancels.
texto: You use AI to find businesses and people showing buying signals (an open position, a new store, an expansion), fill in their contact details, personalize your outreach, and test far more messages than a human team could. You deliver meetings or genuinely interested leads to the client.

It is the “stickiest” business: if you bring in clients and the client makes money from them, they will not cancel. The metric is the easiest to measure. But the requirement is tough: you need to generate your own clients first, or nobody will believe you can generate theirs. People who already run a prospecting agency and add AI have a head start.
negocios.preco: R$ 3,000 to R$ 10,000 per month, or a fee per meeting booked.
negocios.para_quem: People who enjoy sales, numbers, and testing, and are willing to prove the method on themselves.
negocios.armadilha: Mass outreach without targeting. It can send the client’s email and WhatsApp number to spam or get them blocked, damaging their reputation.
comecar: Use the method to get your first 3 clients
Choose an industry and a buying signal (open position, new store, expansion)
Offer a paid 30-day trial, charging per meeting booked
negocios.oferta: I find [type of client] for your calendar, and you pay for the meetings that happen.
negocios.kpi: Meetings booked and sales closed per month

rel.d: Find people showing buying signals and reach out at the right time.
Every incoming lead gets a response right away.

negocios.curta: The most durable of all: people who trust you will follow you when the tools change. But it takes years.
texto: Courses, communities, newsletters, and videos, ideally featuring your face and voice. You need to work with the subject day to day to teach it, or at least feel comfortable on camera. Competition is growing, but so is the number of people who want to learn.

It is the most durable business because people invest in you, not in a tool: when technology changes, you change with it and they stay. The problem is speed. Building an audience takes years, and trust comes from proof. That is why a common path is to offer services and consulting first, then build your brand to launch the other businesses.
negocios.preco: From one-off courses to a community subscription; it depends on the audience’s size and trust.
negocios.para_quem: People with experience to share who enjoy teaching and are willing to build gradually.
negocios.armadilha: Starting with a brand before you have proof. First results, then trust, then an audience.
comecar: Document a real problem you solved each week
Publish on the same channel, on the same day, for 90 days
Bring the people who respond to a mailing list or group you own
negocios.oferta: Every week, I show you how to solve [problem] with AI, using real cases.
negocios.kpi: People on your mailing list or in your community

rel.d: Organize what you know into a named method.
Publish consistently without spending all day on design.

negocios.curta: You are the doctor: learn how the company works, find the bottleneck, and prescribe where AI will save the most.
texto: You go into the company, understand its processes, find the bottleneck, and recommend where AI can save the most time or money. Fixes get cheaper every month; diagnosis still has value. And there is the human part no AI can handle: persuading the team, setting usage rules, and helping people change their habits.

Implementing AI properly in a company takes work, and most of the value lies in that implementation. Consulting pays off faster than education and creates opportunities for automation, customer service, and training projects.
negocios.preco: A diagnostic engagement costs R$ 3,000 to R$ 30,000, plus implementation.
negocios.para_quem: People who understand business, ask good questions, and have already delivered a few AI projects.
negocios.armadilha: Handing over a polished report and leaving. The client pays for change, not for a PDF.
comecar: Offer a one-day diagnostic at a fixed price
Identify 3 opportunities with estimated savings in reais
Propose implementing the first one with a measurable target
negocios.oferta: In one week, I will show you where AI can save the most in your company, in reais, and implement the first solution.
negocios.kpi: Reais saved or earned per month after implementation

rel.nome: AI Consulting: From Diagnosis to Delivery
rel.d: Diagnosis, solution design, pricing, delivery, and growth.
A toolkit for bringing AI to small and medium-sized businesses.

negocios.curta: The top role: take responsibility for a company’s AI strategy, or for several companies at once.
texto: There are two equally good paths. Become the AI lead at the company where you already work, and take responsibility for strategy and results. Or work as a fractional director, serving a few companies at a time for several hours a week each. This is often the natural next step for someone who has done consulting.

More and more companies want someone accountable for AI, and people who combine AI knowledge with business perspective tend to be more valued. It requires knowing enough to avoid being caught off guard and carrying yourself like an executive. As AI advances, people who decide how to use it become more valuable.
negocios.preco: Fractional: R$ 8,000 to R$ 25,000 per month per company. In-house: executive salary.
negocios.para_quem: People with management or consulting experience and the trust of owners and directors.
negocios.armadilha: Wanting the title without the proof. It comes after you have delivered measured results at other companies.
comecar: Choose 1 company where you already have trust
Propose a 90-day engagement with 3 AI-related business goals
Report results to leadership every month
negocios.oferta: I manage your company’s AI a few hours a week: strategy, tools, team, and results.

rel.d: Coordinate multiple agents and teams from one screen.
Agents that discover and validate business opportunities.

degraus.d: Visual things that are quick to show. Good for gaining experience and landing your first clients; prices fall every year.
Customer service, automation, creative assets, AI search. Recurring fees and an easy-to-show metric.
Workshops, consulting, and lead generation. Better pay and a path to bigger projects.
AI director and personal brand. It takes longer to reach this step, but it is harder to replace.

plano.d: Choose one business and one industry. Build the demo using the client’s public information (website, social media, menu) or sample data — never private data without permission.
Show the demo to 20 companies in the industry. Land your first client, even at a low price, in exchange for a testimonial and metrics.
Deliver the work while measuring before and after. Write a case study showing what changed.
Use the case study to sign 3 more clients and offer your first client the service from the next step up.
